headline: EPack Prefab Technologies Limited: Regulation 31(4) Disclosure Under SEBI Takeover Code
sum: EPack Prefab Technologies has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Takeover Regulations Regulation 31(4), signalling either a mandatory offer trigger or a threshold crossing by an acquirer.
implication: Regulation 31(4) filings typically follow 25%+ acquisition of voting shares or a change in control; partners must review the detailed disclosure document (available via NSE) to identify the acquirer, precise stake acquired, consideration, and whether an open offer is mandated under Regulation 38.
detail: EPack Prefab Technologies Limited, a prefabricated building systems manufacturer listed on NSE, has submitted a Regulation 31(4) disclosure to the exchange. This regulation mandates disclosure when a person or group acquires shares crossing specified thresholds (typically 25%, 50%, or 75% of voting capital) or when there is a change in control. The disclosure document, filed with NSE, contains details of the acquirer, shareholding pattern, consideration, and conditions precedent. Open offer obligations under Regulation 38 may be triggered depending on the stake acquired and circumstances.

framework.ref: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, Regulation 31(4)
framework.note: Mandatory disclosure of substantial acquisition crossing 25%, 50%, or 75% voting thresholds or control change; filed with exchange within specified timelines.
Open offer obligation triggered on acquisition of 25% or more voting shares or control; acquirer must make public offer to remaining shareholders at specified price.
Definitions of 'acquirer', 'group', 'control', and 'voting shares' — critical for threshold determination and applicability.
Prohibition on acquisition of shares in excess of prescribed limit without prior approval (if applicable to private companies); public company acquisitions subject to takeover code.
Application scope — covers listed companies and acquisition of 25% or more voting shares; some exemptions (family transfers, inter-se transfers, pledged shares) must be checked.

framework.ref: SEBI Takeover Regulations, 2011, Schedule — Form of Disclosure
framework.note: Prescribed format for Regulation 31(4) disclosure; must include acquirer details, current shareholding, acquisition strategy, funding source, and intention.

framework.ref: Stock Exchange (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, Regulation 30
framework.note: Material event/information disclosure obligations; substantial acquisition may require separate announcement to stock exchange.
If acquisition qualifies as reorganisation, potential tax neutrality; review conditions for Section 47(vi) exemption.

conditions: Acquisition crosses 25%+ voting threshold or results in change of control
Regulation 31(4) disclosure filed with NSE within prescribed timeline
Open offer likely mandatory under Regulation 38 if threshold crossed for first time
approvals: Stock exchange (NSE) filing/approval of Regulation 31(4) disclosure
Open offer approval by SEBI (if triggered)
CCI approval if applicable (deal value/parties may not trigger; review separately)
structure.novel: Regulation 31(4) is a post-event disclosure (after acquisition); the form and timing of disclosure (whether accompanied by an open offer announcement) will indicate deal structure and whether acquirer is a financial or strategic buyer.

triggers.law: SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011
triggers.note: Regulation 31(4) triggers mandatory disclosure; Regulation 38 triggers open offer if 25%+ acquisition or control change.
If deal value or combined entity turnover breaches CCI thresholds (₹3,600 cr turnover or ₹1,800 cr assets), CCI approval required; EPack's size likely requires review.
